data_objects.name: indexed_sector_series
data_objects.meaning: An indexed sequence of numeric measurements for sector-labeled series and a series labeled Full.

variables.name: MedInd
variables.meaning: Numeric series labeled MedInd, apparently referring to a medium-industrial category.

variables.name: LarInd
variables.meaning: Numeric series labeled LarInd, apparently referring to a large-industrial category.

variables.name: Agri
variables.meaning: Numeric series for the category labeled Agri.

variables.name: Residential
variables.meaning: Numeric series for the residential category.

structure.description: Each row is one sequence position identified by Unnamed: 0, with parallel values for all named series.

uncertainties: The measured phenomenon, time or sampling basis, and units are not stated.
The expansions of MedInd and LarInd and the relationship of Full to the sector-labeled series are not explicitly defined.
annotation_notes: The annotation preserves the source labels where their domain semantics are ambiguous.
